text:
Noor Patel: Hey everyone! I’m Noor — joining as an SRE on the infra team. Remote from Toronto but hoping to make it to SF in a month. Pronouns she/her. Big fan of cacti, cold brew, and late-night clarinet practice :raised_hands:

Mike Hernandez: welcome Noor!! :tada: we have a tiny plant swap every quarter if you’re into that. we’ll save a tiny pot for you :)

Julie Rivera: hi Noor :) clarinet? omg yes. we have a weekly music hackers channel if you want to share. also we do a re:free coffee run on Thursdays.

Noor Patel: love that — count me in for the plant swap and the coffee run. would be great to meet folks.

Onboarding Bot: Welcome Noor! Next steps:
  1) Badge pickup at 2nd-floor security desk (bring ID)
  2) Slack + VPN access should be done by EOD
  3) Intro 1:1 scheduled with Sam on Mon 10am

Noor Patel: quick Q — where do I pick up the badge? Is there a specific door?

Sam (People Ops): @Noor Patel — head to the main lobby on 4th Ave, tell security you’re with Redwood Inference, they’ll hand you the badge. If you want to speed it up, ping me and I can meet you.

Mike Hernandez: FYI parking is limited, but there’s a public lot 2 blocks east (metered).

Anya Patel: welcome! also adding a tiny poll idea: react with :cactus: if you bring plants to the office, :coffee: if you need coffee every morning, :music: if you’d join a jam session.

Noor Patel: :cactus: :coffee: :music: (all three)

Julie Rivera: also: pro-tip — badge activation sometimes takes a few minutes. if it doesn’t work, reboot the turnstile or ask security to re-scan.

Noor Patel: noted, thanks! excited to be here — looking forward to meeting everyone in person. :wave:

Mike Hernandez: welcome again Noor. if you want a low-key first-week intro, we usually do lunch on Wed in the kitchen table area. bring your clarinet for dessert :)

Sam (People Ops): added Noor to the #music-hackers and #plant-swap channels. see you soon! :sparkles:
